title: Merchant tile state
description: A merchant tile in one commerce slot. 5 slots in play at 2 seats, 7 at 3, 9 at 4.

merchant-id.description: Board-location id of the commerce location this tile sits on.

slot-index.description: Which of that location's tile slots. Shrewsbury has only index 0.

buys.description: Industries this tile accepts. Empty with all=false means a blank tile that accepts NOTHING, not a wildcard.

all.description: True on the single wildcard tile: accepts any sellable good. When true, buys is empty.

beer.description: The free barrel. Starts at 1 on every non-blank tile, 0 on a blank one. Spending it fires the location's merchant bonus. Reset at the era transition.
